sources.reading_verification: The complete author-hosted 107-page PDF and the relevant derivations were inspected. §I.1.3 states the variational sensitivity result; §§I.3.1–I.3.3 distinguish BVP and branch existence; §I.4.1 gives the shooting residual and Jacobian; §I.4.2 gives an unstable shooting example; §I.4.3 gives multiple-shooting residuals and the block Jacobian. The local sensitivity, conditioning and error proofs in this batch are authored in full and do not rely on an unstated source proof.

item_arguments.argument: Prove the derivative with common-tube difference quotients, a variational integral equation, and Gronwall; the incomplete candidate source is not needed.
Compose the boundary map with the certified approximate endpoint map, differentiate that numerical residual, and apply finite-budget Newton with explicit statuses.
Assemble segment endpoint mismatch rows and the boundary row, then use the verified sparse block Jacobian and finite-budget residual procedure.
Derive the transfer recurrence for the normalized midpoint Jacobian, prove transfer convergence to the continuous fundamental matrix, and use the bounded continuous BVP inverse.
Use the exact-sample O(h^2) residual, uniform discrete inverse, uniform Hessian bound, and a contraction on a fixed ball.
